title: Sponsor cell isolation profiles with SharedStoreRegister
objective: Isolate each legal sponsor in its own cell (schema and role, dedicated database, or dedicated infrastructure), list every cross-tenant store with permitted fields, and record the profile in effect over time.
implementing_systems: not yet assigned (Unbound persistence and control plane)

title: Tenant derived from server-held entitlements; client hints ignored
objective: Derive the tenant for every request from the authenticated principal's entitlements, accept only server-issued opaque selection tokens, revalidate per request, and ignore client-supplied tenant, schema, database or host values.

title: Pooled connection reset and allowlisted schema binding
objective: Bind an allowlisted schema and tenant role per transaction without identifier interpolation or mutable search path, and reset role, settings and search path before pooling.

title: VerifiedTenantContext as a required, privately constructed type
objective: Require a VerifiedTenantContext, constructible only by the trusted resolver, to open any unit of work or issue any query in governed application modules.
implementing_systems: not yet assigned (tenant-bound data access layer; Strata does not provide one)
residual_risks: Reflection and unchecked defaults can construct private values.
Resolver defects produce well-typed wrong tenants.
notes: Illustrative F# contracts exist in unbound@9b38de47:architecture/TENANT-AWARE-PERSISTENCE-DESIGN.md and are explicitly not compiled.

title: Analyzer prohibition of raw connections, reflection and unsafe code in governed modules
objective: Fail the build if governed modules open raw database connections, use reflection to construct private types, load code dynamically or use unsafe interop.
implementing_systems: not yet assigned (F# analyzers; Roslyn analyzers)
notes: The Standard proposes Aegis for semantic analysis, but Aegis is verified to be a fault-handling library; analyzer ownership is unassigned.

title: Cell-confined grants and forced RLS declared and gated
objective: Declare per-cell roles, grants and forced row-level security in Strata; fail release if any tenant table lacks enabled and forced RLS, any tenant role holds privileges outside its cell, any grant is to PUBLIC, or any application role has BYPASSRLS.
implementing_systems: Strata (grant and RLS declaration, drift comparison, noGrantsToPublic invariant; pilot)
not yet assigned (forced-RLS and cell-confinement check)
residual_risks: Strata does not report privileges of roles the project never names.

title: SECURITY DEFINER, search path and catalog exposure controls
objective: Prohibit unreviewed SECURITY DEFINER routines in tenant schemas, require pinned search paths, and use non-identifying schema, role and object names in shared clusters.

title: Isolation test matrix as a release gate
objective: Run cross-tenant read and write, spoofed routing, pooled leakage, background job, cache, index and AI retrieval tests per profile against real PostgreSQL on every build; block release on failure.

title: Production cross-tenant canary probes
objective: Continuously attempt cross-tenant access from synthetic canary tenants through public interfaces and alert on any success or anomaly; record all denials.

title: Tenant-keyed secondary stores
objective: Bind cache keys, queue topics, index partitions, object storage prefixes and log attributes to the typed tenant context; list each in the isolation map.

title: Tenant-scoped AI retrieval and model data use
objective: Retrieve AI context only through the governed query layer under the user's tenant context, log retrieved resource IDs, partition embeddings per cell, and prohibit cross-tenant training or evaluation without documented rights.

title: Per-cell key hierarchy with application-layer field encryption and cryptographic erasure
objective: Encrypt each cell under its own keys, encrypt sensitive fields at the application layer, support customer-held root keys where contracted, and erase by dual-controlled key destruction with certificate.
implementing_systems: not yet assigned (managed key service; key hierarchy undecided)

title: Per-tenant quotas, fair scheduling and per-cell migrations
objective: Enforce per-tenant rate limits, query timeouts, pool and job quotas, priority queues with fairness for time-critical work, per-tenant monitoring, and independent per-cell migration failure handling.

title: Typed partner partitions, isolated embeds and validated branding
objective: Confine partner users, APIs and widgets to their channel and sponsor-authorized data classes; isolate embedded components; validate branding and sender identity per program; terminate partner access at exit.
implementing_systems: Limen (browser boundary; not an isolation mechanism by itself)

title: Governed tenant lifecycle with isolation readiness and verifiable export
objective: Require isolation tests to pass before ReadinessValidated, fence single writers during migration with record equivalence and independent reconciliation, and deliver a signed, reconcilable ExitPackage.
